title: Warsaw Ghetto Uprising
note: Armed Jewish civilian resistance in the Warsaw Ghetto from 19 April to 16 May 1943 against SS liquidation forces, representing the largest single urban Jewish revolt during World War II.

title: Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide
note: First human rights treaty adopted by the United Nations General Assembly, codifying genocide in international law following Raphael Lemkin's campaign in the wake of the Holocaust.

title: Porajmos: The Romani Genocide
note: The systematic racial genocide of Roma and Sinti populations by Nazi Germany and its allies, murdering between 250,000 and 500,000 victims; an under-recorded atrocity in European historiography.

title: Primo Levi
note: Italian Jewish chemist, anti-fascist partisan, Auschwitz-Monowitz survivor, and author whose landmark testimony 'If This Is a Man' established vital ethical and psychological documentation of the camps.
